title: Household Income by DUN
description: Mean and median gross monthly household income by DUN constituency from 2019 to 2024.

fields.name: state
fields.title: State
fields.description: [Categorical] One of 13 states with a state legislative assembly; the 3 Federal Territories are excluded as they do not have State Legislative Assemblies.

fields.name: parlimen
fields.title: Parliamentary Constituency
fields.description: [Categorical] One of 207 parliamentary constituencies; the 15 constituencies in Federal Territories are excluded as they are not subdivided into DUNs.

fields.name: date
fields.title: Date
fields.description: [Date] The date in YYYY-MM-DD format, with MM-DD set to 01-01 as the data is at annual frequency

fields.name: income_mean
fields.title: Mean Income
fields.description: [Integer, RM] Average gross monthly household income

fields.name: income_median
fields.title: Median Income
fields.description: [Integer, RM] Median gross monthly household income; this is generally less than the mean income due to the right-skewed distribution of income

methodology:
Data on individual salaries and wages [in the formal economy](https://open.dosm.gov.my/dashboard/formal-sector-wages) is easy to obtain from administrative records. However, data on household income is more difficult to tabulate, as it requires the correct definition of a statistical household, as well as the inclusion of non-salary sources of income such as property income, dividends, and interest. For this reason, it requires the use of a representative survey or census.

 In Malaysia, data on household income (as well as expenditure and access to basic amenities) is collected through the Household Income and Expenditure Survey (HIES), which is conducted at least twice within any 5-year period. The data shown here was tabulated from household-level HIES records spanning 2019 to 2024 (the latest edition). For a full description of the methodology, please refer to the [technical notes](https://open.dosm.gov.my/publications/technical-notes/hies-technotes).
caveat: This data presents nominal values, i.e. they have not been adjusted for inflation. Furthermore, DUN-level data is only published from 2019 (relative to [state-level data](https://open.dosm.gov.my/data-catalogue/hh_income_state) which is available from 1970) as prior HIES samples were not sufficient to support DUN-level granularity.
